title: Qayamat ki tapish hai
body:
qayamat ki tapish hai karbala ka dasht jalta hai
madine ka musafir khaakh par karwat badalta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan hai hazrate ayyub dekhe sabr ke johar
jawan beta hai godhi may pidar ki dam nikalta hai
<<MINI>>
qayamat ki tapish hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sheh ne yeh baano se ke khaime may chali jao
ali asghar ka manka dhal chuka ab dam nikalta hai
<<MINI>>
qayamat ki tapish hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
layeeno sayyade sajjad par kode na barsao
bahut beemar hai is waaste ruk ruk kay chalta hai
<<MINI>>
qayamat ki tapish hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh poocha karte thay tifli may akbar sheh se kyon baba
jawani may jo maut aaye to dam kyon-kar nikalta hai
<<MINI>>
qayamat ki tapish hai...

zara utkar lahad se dekh lijay ya rasool allah
janaze par janaza aap ke ghar se nikalta hai
